0022600004.text: Both the Miami Heat and Minnesota Timberwolves open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, which Miami hosts. The Heat will be without Keshad Johnson, who is out with a hamstring injury, and the Timberwolves are missing Donte DiVincenzo, who is out following Achilles surgery. Minnesota took both meetings in 2025-26, including a 122-94 win in Minnesota on January 6, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Heat a 50% chance to win.
